+        Raises:

+        if isinstance(requirement, str):

+        if not dep:

+
+# Test cases
+test_cases = [
+    ("==1.2.3", True),      # Exact version - should be pinned
+    ("==1.2.*", True),      # Wildcard version - should be pinned (this was the bug)
+    ("==1.2.3.0a1", True),  # Pre-release version - should be pinned
+    (">=1.2.3", False),     # Greater than or equal - should not be pinned
+    ("<2.0.0", False),      # Less than - should not be pinned
+    ("~=1.2.3", False),     # Compatible release - should not be pinned
+    ("!=1.2.3", False),     # Not equal - should not be pinned
+]
+
+print("Testing is_pinned_requirement function:")
+for specifier_str, expected in test_cases:
+    spec = SpecifierSet(specifier_str)
+    result = is_pinned_requirement(spec)
